description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person wants an AI agent saved for a system this account already has connected, such as the sub-accounts an installed app reaches or a system they signed in to. Without confirm it saves nothing and returns a review: per account whether a new agent is saved or an existing one gets these settings, the package, what it may do per record type, the action groups and what cannot be kept. With confirm true it saves that setup and returns each saved agent with its status and link. Not for a system that is not connected yet (use plan_ai_agent), and not for syncing two systems (use plan_integration).

access.description: What the assistant may do per record type: read, or read_write to also change them. Left out, it reads every record type the system offers.

appointment.description: What the assistant may do with appointment records.

contact.description: What the assistant may do with contact records.

deal.description: What the assistant may do with deal records.

estimate.description: What the assistant may do with estimate records.

invoice.description: What the assistant may do with invoice records.

job.description: What the assistant may do with job records.

opportunity.description: What the assistant may do with opportunity records.

accounts.description: Which connected accounts or sub-accounts, by name or id as the review lists them; all names every connected one without an AI agent yet. Leave it out when only one is connected.

action_groups.description: Optional groups of the system's own actions to switch on, as get_ai_agents_info names them for that system.

confirm.description: True only after the person confirmed the review of this same setup in this conversation.

package.description: analyst reads only (AI Analyst); agent also changes records, each change shown first (AI Agent). Left out, a change asked for anywhere makes it agent.

system.description: The system the agent works in, by its key.

name: set_up_ai_agent
title: Set up an AI agent
